A signer's relays could all be marked dead without a single network change happening.

Amber 6.6.7, published 5 October 2026, fixes two separate defects in one retry counter. RelayHealthTracker stops dialling a relay once it passes MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS, which is 10, and in 6.6.6 that state was cleared only by a successful connection, an OS network change or a manual reconnect. A Wi-Fi network that lost internet and got it back is none of those, so nothing expired it. The release adds DEAD_COOLDOWN_MS of 15 minutes, after which the relay is eligible again.

The second defect is the sharper one. Quartz reports a failed dial as onCannotConnect followed by onDisconnected, and both handlers recorded a failure. The documented threshold of 10 was really 5.

A counter that is wrong by a factor of two is harder to see than a counter that is wrong, because the behaviour it produces is still plausible.

We read every merged NIP and every release diff in the clients and relays we track, and we report from the diff rather than the changelog. Do you know what your signer does after eleven failed dials to the same relay?

Nineteen new tests ship with it, and the changelog and the diff agree on all four entries. Whether any device is running 6.6.7 is a separate question: store and repository channels move at their own pace.

Amber 6.6.7 makes a relay's dead state expire. RelayHealthTracker gives up on a relay after MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS of 10, and in 6.6.6 only a successful connection, an OS network change or a manual reconnect cleared that. A Wi-Fi that lost internet and got it back is none of them, so relays stayed dead until the app was force closed. DEAD_COOLDOWN_MS is now 15 minutes.

And the threshold was never really 10. Quartz reports a failed dial as onCannotConnect then onDisconnected, and both recorded a failure, so five failed dials reached a limit documented as ten.

Same release: relay sockets are rebuilt on VPN up and down and on regained internet access, and requests from browsers other than Chrome no longer fail with Unknown signer type.
